title: Soft-Radiation-Induced Decoherence of Heavy-Quark Spin Entanglement at the Electron-Ion Collider
summary: Using the soft-gluon theorem, we identify a soft-recoil mechanism by which unresolved gluon radiation induces decoherence in the spin correlations of heavy quark-antiquark pairs produced by longitudinally polarized virtual photons in deep-inelastic scattering. Upon tracing over the unresolved gluon, the reduced spin density matrix is block diagonal in the mirror parity of the production plane and is governed by two coefficients: a parity-odd normal-spin flip, which reduces the normal-axis correlation, and a parity-even stochastic rotation of the spin-correlation plane about its normal, which…
